verdict.rationale: Square documents its own Sandbox testing environment ('Test in Sandbox'), and it ships in-person surfaces (Mobile Payments SDK, Terminal API), so a first-party pre-launch test environment exists. The evidence is only a page title, though; nothing shows a simulated reader, in-person test cards, or end-to-end coverage of in-person flows. Missing for 10: documented simulated/mock reader support, in-person test card values, explicit sandbox coverage of the Mobile Payments SDK and Terminal API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test my in-person integration end-to-end with a simulated reader or test card environment before going live
